_comment: Rules are evaluated in order; the first one whose conditions ALL match wins.
sample_rate is a percentage: 100 keeps everything, 10 keeps ~1 in 10, 0 drops all.
Survivors get weight = floor(100 / sample_rate) so Moesif extrapolates back.
Prefer rates that divide 100 evenly (50, 25, 20, 10, 5, 4, 2, 1) -- others
round the weight down and under-report.
Order matters: put the keep-everything rules first, or they get sampled away.
Ships keeping everything. Add rules here, or override the whole file with the
SAMPLING_CONFIG env var -- either way, no code change.
operators: equals not_equals in not_in regex contains gt gte lt lte between
exists not_exists     (+ "ignore_case": true on string compares)
paths are dotted: response.status, request.verb, request.headers.x-client-id
request.route is derived from request.uri: the path only, no host or query
Rename _example_rules to rules to switch the example on.
